source.kind: 19 user-supplied entries plus 1 official related-paper citation

selection_policy: Preserve 19 selected user entries unchanged; replace ROBULA+ with official Stable-Baselines3 metadata to supply a positive JMLR control.
expectation_policy: Coverage intents are not frozen live-service verdicts. Confirmed source matches, version differences and source failures must be reported separately.

coverage_notes: The core bibliography supplies all six providers; controlled metadata checks are in rule-variants.bib.
Parser, AUX, transport and lifecycle cases use explicit fixtures/scenarios listed in coverage-matrix.json.
Live lookup outcomes are observations, not gold labels; protocol replays use source-linked metadata excerpts.
